hero.sub: Premium hoodies and tees in organic cotton, oversized fit, soft colours. Made in small batches, pre-order only. Born from a friendship, built to last.

story.lead: KODA is two friends who couldn't find the perfect hoodie: heavy enough to last for years, soft enough to never take off, in colours you don't see everywhere. So we made it. No overstock, no compromise, no bullshit.
story.v1: 400 gsm organic cotton, reinforced seams, dense embroidery. A hoodie you keep, not one you replace.
story.v2: No loud logo, no disposable trend. Simple pieces, worn by us first.
story.v3: For the people who make it, the planet, and you: fair prices, made to order, free returns.

specs.title: Heavy outside,
specs.fabricText: 100% organic cotton fleece, 400 gsm, brushed inside. Pre-washed: no shrinking.
specs.fitText: Oversized drop shoulders for hoodies, boxy for tees. Length designed to sit right, not to float.
specs.detailsText: Embroidered chest logo, thick ribbing, tonal flat drawcords, woven label at the neck.
specs.makingText: Sewn by a partner workshop in Portugal, embroidered and quality-checked in France. Small batches on pre-order.
specs.careText: Wash at 30°, inside out, no tumble dryer. It ages well if you respect it.

newsletter.title: 24 h ahead
newsletter.text: Drops go fast. The list gets the link 24 hours before everyone else, plus a 10% welcome code.
